verdict.rationale: Bevy is an open-source engine used as a normal Rust dependency, and its Scene system documents saving ECS worlds, which is a first-party way to persist project data. The evidence does not say what format scenes use or that any complete export exists. glTF is documented only as an import format, and the MIT/Apache licensing shows ownership of the tool, not data export. Missing for 10: documented open serialization format for saved scenes, a complete export of all project data, export-side open-format support (glTF is load-only in evidence), independent corroboration of leaving without lock-in.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Create, save, and load ECS worlds using Bevy's Scene system
